Class BinaryLinearSearch

java.lang.Object
BinaryLinearSearch
public class BinaryLinearSearch extends Object
this class has all the methods that for linear and binary search in two way. 1 : iteration 2 : recursion Also, it has method to generate random character and printing them on console.
